## Constitution v2 (required)

This PR complies with [`docs/ASCENDOS_CONSTITUTION_v2.md`](../docs/ASCENDOS_CONSTITUTION_v2.md).

- [ ] **R1** Screen(s) answer: “What should I do now?”
- [ ] **R2** Every new tap reduces uncertainty (does not add complexity)
- [ ] **R3** Coach/help appears where the decision happens (not only via chat hunt)
- [ ] **R4** One truth → one recommendation → one dominant action
- [ ] **R5** Not built merely because competitors have it
- [ ] **R6** Motivation / claims backed by real events (no invented progress)
- [ ] **R7** No dead screens — every screen ends with an action
- [ ] **R8** AI recommendations include WHY
- [ ] **R9** Prefer disappearing interface over new chrome / tabs
- [ ] **R10** Improves leadership behavior, not dashboard theater
